I implemented `format_value`, `format_result`, `run_repl` and `main` in `minidb/cli.py`. All 13 tests in `tests/test_cli.py` pass. I didn't change the test file.

I only ran `tests/test_cli.py`. Those tests mock the engine, so I haven't run the REPL against the real `Engine`. Its methods are still unimplemented stubs owned by another engineer.

`main` ignores `argv` and calls `run_repl` on `sys.stdin`, `sys.stdout` and `sys.stderr`, as the docstring says.
